zh: 组件可以导出成 .dshw 再导入回来，看板可以导出成 .dshboard（带上它用到的全部组件；数据与状态默不带，带 ?data=true 才带）。解包前校验路径、扩展名、文件数与大小；同 id 不同内容先回 409 并给出两边的哈希，带上 replace 才覆盖，内置与插件提供的组件永远不被覆盖。组件库浮窗里每一格有「导出」，头部有「导入」。
en: A widget can be exported as .dshw and imported back, and a board as .dshboard with every widget it uses embedded (data and state are left out unless ?data=true). Packages are checked for paths, extensions, file count and size before they are unpacked; the same id with different content answers 409 and names both hashes, and only replace overwrites — built-in and plugin-provided widgets are never overwritten. Each tile in the library panel has an Export, and its header has an Import.
